debate: Alright, let’s get things rolling. We lost Isaac last night, but we haven’t heard a single theory yet. I propose we go around and each share one initial gut feeling or hunch—no need for rock-solid evidence, just what you’re sensing about someone. I’ll start the list of speakers: Jackson, then Derek, Will, Leah, Ginger, and Dan. Jackson, what’s your first impression?
My gut feeling right now is on Jackson—he sounded way too measured when he spoke, almost like he was covering his tracks instead of just sharing a hunch.
I’m not fully sold on Jackson yet, but my gut’s actually on Ginger—she’s been totally quiet so far, and at this stage of the game silence feels like hiding something.

I actually have my eye on Bert. He was super quick to lay out the whole speaking order but hasn’t offered any real read on anyone—feels like a subtle power move. Dan’s been oddly quiet too, which makes me uneasy this early on. For now, I’d keep Bert under the microscope and watch Dan’s next comment before turning to Ginger.

Thanks everyone for sharing. I find Will’s early accusation of me pretty striking—no real evidence, just a gut feeling that feels like deflection. I’m inclined to keep an eye on him. Before we dig deeper, I’d like to hear from Ginger and Dan—what’s your initial hunch? Let’s keep the ideas flowing so we can narrow down our suspect list.

Thanks for the floor, Jackson. I’ve been listening closely, and my gut right now is on Derek. He jumped in accusing me without any real rationale—that kind of baseless projection rings alarm bells. I don’t have concrete proof yet, but his defensiveness is suspicious. Dan, you’ve been quiet—what do you make of Derek’s quick attack? And Leah, do you have any more thoughts on Bert or others before we narrow in?

I’m with Ginger that Derek’s knee-jerk on Ginger feels more like projection than insight. Derek—what specifically did you notice in Ginger’s behavior that made you jump on her? And Leah—when you say Bert’s move was a subtle power play, can you give an example of what struck you as unnatural? Let’s get real details before we lock on anyone.
